descr: Gemini 3.8 Flash leads Kimi K3.1 Pro in Arena chat votes, while Kimi K3.1 Pro scores higher in coding.
risposta: Gemini 3.8 Flash is ahead in the overall Arena ranking, scoring 1497 points compared to Kimi K3.1 Pro’s 1485. The chat score gives Gemini a clear lead, while Kimi beats Gemini in coding. Overall, Gemini 3.8 Flash is the better chat model, but Kimi K3.1 Pro excels at code generation.
dimensioni: Gemini 3.8 Flash does not disclose its model size. Kimi K3.1 Pro is 2780.1 B total, with 104.8 B active, and requires about 1686 GB to download in 4-bit format.
velocita: Both models need online access only; none fit on any listed home GPU or workstation configuration. Gemini 3.8 Flash and Kimi K3.1 Pro are unavailable for local off-load on RTX 3090, RTX 4090, RTX 5090, RX 7900 XTX, Mac M4 Max 128 GB, or Ryzen AI Max+ 395 128 GB.
gratisA: Gemini 3.8 Flash can be accessed for free through Google’s Gemini API free tier. The API uses a proprietary license and does not require a local download.
gratisB: Kimi K3.1 Pro is free to use by downloading the open weights and running the model at home under the Kimi K3.1 Pro License.
sceglieA: Pick Gemini 3.8 Flash when you need the strongest chat performance according to Arena votes. It is ideal if you prefer a cloud-based solution with a free API and do not want to manage large model files.
sceglieB: Choose Kimi K3.1 Pro if coding tasks are your priority, as it leads in the coding category. It also suits users who want full control by running the model locally and who can handle the large download size.

categorie.Chat: Gemini 3.8 Flash scores 1497 in the chat category, outpacing Kimi K3.1 Pro’s 1485. It is the better option for general conversation.
categorie.Coding: Kimi K3.1 Pro leads coding with 1686 points versus Gemini 3.8 Flash’s 1583. It is the stronger choice for programming assistance.
